ui.thorax.title: Thorax
item.thorax.cabbage_butterfly.descriptio: A common, small, white butterfly with characteristic black spots. As larva, they feast upon leafy vegetables such as lettuce and broccoli, but switch to eating flower nectar as adults.
item.thorax.agrias_butterfly.description: A fast-flying butterfly that feasts upon rotting fruit and organic matter. Its striking coloration gives the impression to would-be predators that it is toxic.
item.thorax.monarch_butterfly.descriptio: A rare sight in the rest of the world but a commonality among the gilded heights of the Golden Isles. They spread their wings and soak up the sun to reinvigorate themselves.
item.thorax.blazing_daggerwing.descripti: Warm-blooded ancient butterflies unfortunate enough to end up stranded in the Nether had to make some adaptations, learning to feast upon the native fungi and seek the gentle warmth of glowstone clusters.
item.thorax.arctic_apollo.description: In order to survive the harsh cold, these critters take infrequent hibernation-like naps in tree cavities and caverns.
item.thorax.miller_moth.description: A mindless insect that gets easily disoriented by light sources. As larvae, they feast upon leaves and switch to a nectar based diet as adults.
item.thorax.luna_moth.description: A dazzling moth that dances through the Golden Isles at night, acting as a lunar counterpart to the Monarchs of the daytime. These moths don't seem to consume anything, perhaps they subsist off of some magical source?
item.thorax.caccophomoth.description: Completely blind dwellers of the dark that have evolved to become completely silent to avoid the killer keeper of the sculk.
item.thorax.praying_mantis.description: A lethal hunter that hides among foliage before striking with their deadly claws. To the ancients, they became emblems of the wilds, their lethality, their poise.
item.thorax.cathode_scorpion.description: An inexplicable genetic mutation led to this scorpion developing the ability to store electric charge instead of venom, injecting lethal doses of it from its stinger. In a pinch, they can replenish it by poising their stinger as a lightning rod of sorts.
item.thorax.red_.description: Legend speaks of an elusive hunter found deep in the caverns. I encountered this creature once, I nearly caught it in my net, but it was swiftly cut through by a sharp appendage it possessed.
